summary: Tested text-case normalization across backend (persons/companies/teams/register-organization/platform preview+apply) and frontend (Super Admin sidebar label, /piattaforma/demo title, normalize card on /piattaforma Organizzazioni tab, EntityDialog on-blur normalization on /staff-volontari, mobile 390px). 7/8 backend assertions pass, 1 confirmed bug: PUT /api/persons/{id} (and all crud_routes PUT endpoints) do NOT normalize fields on update — spec requires ALWAYS normalize before save. Frontend acceptance OK: sidebar shows 'Prenotazioni demo', page H1 is 'Prenotazioni demo', normalize-card + normalize-analyze testid present, Analizza returns 27 proposals, on-blur in person dialog converts 'mARIO'→'Mario' and "d'amico"→"D'Amico". No apply was executed against non-test data. All created TEST_ records cleaned up.

critical.endpoint: PUT /api/persons/{id} (and all crud_routes PUT: companies, teams, deals, staff, events, maps, activities, followups, lodgings, meals)
critical.issue: Update path does NOT call TN.normalize_fields — sending cognome='DE LUCA' stores 'DE LUCA' instead of 'De Luca'. server.py line 1447 uses body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) directly, bypassing normalization used only in generic _update helper (line 582). Spec requires ALWAYS normalize backend-side on save.

issues: All proposed rows are pre-checked by default; 'Applica selezionate (9)' is clickable immediately. Request wording ('only on confirm') is honoured since a click is still required, but defaulting all to checked could cause accidental mass updates — consider defaulting to unchecked.

action_items: Fix PUT normalization: in crud_routes (server.py ~L1446-L1448) wrap clean through TN.normalize_fields(coll, clean) before $set. Same gap likely in any other PUT handlers that build $set manually (verify companies/teams/structures/users PUTs and leads/organization PUT at L4127 — organization PUT does normalize nome but doesn't normalize citta/regione/nazione if those get added).
critical_code_review_comments: crud_routes _u skips TN.normalize_fields while _c uses _create which normalizes — asymmetric; collapse to _update helper.

text_normalize.business_name treats any token containing a digit as untouched (line 42: 'any(c.isdigit() for c in w)'), so 'via roma 10' → 'Via Roma 10' works (connector 'roma' is capitalized, '10' kept) but a token like 'asd2024' would be fully untouched which may be intended.
FIELD_RULES.users maps both 'name' and 'nome' — the duplicate 'nome' key is correct for consistency but confirm db schema actually stores 'name' for users (seen in /auth/me).

The platform preview endpoint currently shows 27 real proposals including 'Org Social b 1790602402935'→'Org Social B 1790602402935' — looks correct.
rca of the issue: PUT in generic crud_routes (server.py L1413-L1480) was written before text_normalize integration. _create at L1432 calls _create() which includes TN.normalize_fields. _u at L1446 builds its own clean dict with body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) and never passes through TN.normalize_fields, so edits bypass the global rule. Fix: insert `clean = TN.normalize_fields(coll, clean)` right after line 1447.
